name: Jet Wyvern
description: A supersonic defense dragon that uses speed to repel all attacks. Jet Wyvern's afterburner legs generate a wind barrier that drains the enemy's stamina on every collision.

ability.name: Afterburn Blitz
ability.description: Jet Wyvern launches a 4-hit supersonic barrage. Each hit has a 50% chance to apply Afterburn to the enemy: they lose 1.5 stamina per Afterburn stack (max 3 stacks total across all hits). After the barrage, Jet Wyvern ignores defense on its next normal Attack.

special_move.name: Jet Sonic Fang
special_move.description: Jet Wyvern breaks the sound barrier — four razor-wing strikes so fast the opponent cannot mount a defense!
flavour_texts: 🦢 **Jet Sonic Fang** — four sonic blasts from the wings of the supersonic wyvern!
